info.name: NexHealth Adjustment Types Patient Recalls API

params.name: subdomain
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified institution

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: First item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: end_cursor
params.description: Last item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Maximum allowed amount is 1000.

params.name: location_id
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified location

params.name: recall_id
params.description: Filter by the id of the associated recall type

params.name: patient_id
params.description: Filter by the id of the associated patient

params.name: foreign_id
params.description: Filter by the EHR id of the recall

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Return records updated since the specified date/time in ISO8601 format

params.name: due_after
params.description: Return recalls due on or after the specified date/time in ISO8601 format

params.name: sort
params.description:
Optional comma-separated string of fields to sort on.
Include a leading dash for descending order.

Available fields:
  * date_due
  * -date_due

items.docs: This endpoint returns the patient recalls for the specified location, narrowed down by the optional filters configured.
